title: Style instruction prefix is read aloud
what: Prefixing 'warm, slow, unhurried, like an elder telling a story:' to the Amharic line made gemini-3.8-flash-tts speak part of the instruction: a ~2.7 s line came out at 9.1-10.4 s (radio cut slots were 11 s for a 6-word line).
fix: style_mode: none (default) in providers.yaml; plain text with voice name only. 'Say warmly:' prefix gave 4.6 s, still longer than plain text (2.7-3.4 s).
